text: I've known Dr. Benz since I was a child. When I learned that he specialized in front teeth, and I had a problem with gaps between my front teeth, I came for a consultation to fill the gaps between my teeth. Initially, I liked the clinic since it was beautiful and spacious, comfortable to the eye. The dental room had modern equipment, and there were natural light openings so I could see the color of my teeth well. When I had the dental work done, the doctor had a gentle and meticulous touch. He also wore glasses with a magnifying glass, so I could see the details clearly. The result was close-fitting teeth, natural-looking, and the color was the same as the teeth next to them, so you could hardly tell that the gaps were filled. The doctor said he used three colors to mix together to get a beautiful result. The attached picture is my own teeth.
